title: FPS Flood
description: This modpack adds quality of life mods and a lot of FPS mods to boost FPS.
body:
# FPS Flood – by Pixelforge Collective

  Do you like [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) mod? Then come take a look [FPS Flood: Create](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fps-flood-create/)

FPS Flood is a performance-focused Minecraft modpack built to improve FPS, responsiveness, and overall gameplay smoothness while enhancing the vanilla experience with modern quality-of-life upgrades.

The modpack includes a carefully tested collection of optimization mods, interface improvements, and additional settings designed to make Minecraft feel cleaner, faster, and more customizable — especially on large multiplayer servers.
Features:

Major FPS and performance improvements
Better optimization for large servers
Enhanced UI and menu improvements
Additional graphics and gameplay settings
Quality-of-life upgrades

Carefully tested and optimized mod selection
Lightweight and smooth gameplay experience
FPS Flood keeps the core Minecraft experience familiar while refining it with modern enhancements and performance-focused improvements.

Notes:
* The standard version of FPS Flood is not designed for shader optimization. Heavy shaders may still significantly impact FPS depending on your hardware. 
* Recommended 4GB allocated. 
* This modpack was tested on old hardware (and DDR3L RAM.)
* For best results, set your resolution to what your GPU is designed for.

Patreon Edition: The Patreon version of FPS Flood includes additional optimizations focused on improving shader performance and delivering more stable FPS while or while not using shaders. Performance results may vary depending on hardware and shader settings.
